metadata.description: Claude Code mods for long sessions: sitrep boxes each reply's outcome and open questions; ctx-relay tracks context and hands off before it fills up.

plugins.name: ctx-relay
plugins.description: A band with context size, per-turn cost and the prompt-cache countdown; past the handoff line it writes a handoff file, runs /clear and resumes in the new conversation.

plugins.name: sitrep
plugins.description: A box under each long reply, built from the reply's own lines: status, outcome, what you have to do, collapsible sections, and questions you answer from the keyboard.
